mentions.name: Discord TCG
mentions.description: A Discord-based digital trading card game (TCG) platform that provides an accessible, customizable social card game experience. Players can use their own media for card images or generate pixel art cards from text descriptions via an integrated free AI.
mentions.source_excerpt: Hit some speed bumps but still building out a Discord-based digital TCG platform. Discord felt like a natural social context for an accessible and customizable experience. Users can use their own media for card images, but it's also integrated with a free pixel art AI that generates cards based on description.
